text:
maya: urgent heads-up — embeddings returning intermittent 502s for short prompts in prod-eu. I bisected to a tokenizer fallback edge on token boundary. I have a hotfix build (tokenizer-v2.3.1-hotfix) that passes unit + staging integration. Requesting expedited ops clearance to do a staged canary (5% -> 25% -> 100%) starting within 20m. @kevin @sasha @ops-duty pls review and stamp.

kevin: looked at staging logs — no regressions on p50/p95, +1 if rollback is automatic and we pin image digest for Dedicated customers.

sasha: what are the explicit abort/rollback criteria? need that spelled out before approve.

maya: rollback plan: auto-rollback if 5xx rate increases >2% absolute vs baseline sustained for 5m OR latency p50 increase >150ms. manual rollback cmd: `/deploybot rollback service=embedder version=previous` and we keep the previous image on standby. Release notes draft available: https://short.redwood/release/6312 (staging notes).

ops-duty: oncall acked — watching. Need pinned sha for Dedicated and a CS blurb. Will only approve after pin included. Also want change window (30m).

riya: for Dedicated, pin to image sha `sha256:abcd1234ef56...7890`. Add migration note that existing sessions are unaffected.

deploybot: deploybot: initiating staged deploy: service=embedder image=tokenizer-v2.3.1-hotfix canary=5% -> 25% -> 100%. Command: `deploybot rollout --service embedder --image tokenizer-v2.3.1-hotfix --strategy staged --steps 5,25,100 --auto-rollback on-error`. Starting canary now.

kevin: watching metrics, set alerts to pager if error spike >1.5%.

sasha: security reviewed the diff, no elevated privileges or new network rules. :thumbsup:

ops-duty: granting expedited approval. Marking change window now +30m from canary start. CS notified to expect brief spike notice. @maya paste the release note body here.

maya: Release note (paste): "Fix: tokenizer boundary case causing intermittent 502s for short prompts on embeddings. Rollout: staged canary with auto-rollback on error spike. Hotfix: tokenizer-v2.3.1-hotfix. Dedicated: pinned to sha256:abcd1234ef56...7890."

deploybot: deploybot: canary traffic 5% applied to prod-eu. Monitoring baseline metrics for 5m window.

maya: canary green at 10m — error rate flat, latency stable. proceeding to 25%.

deploybot: deploybot: canary 25% applied. telemetry window 10m.

kevin: metrics look clean at 25%. no anomalies on p50/p95 or error rate. +1 to proceed to 100% rollout.

maya: proceeding to 100% now, ETA ~15m to fully ramp.

deploybot: deploybot: ramping to 100%...

deploybot: deploybot: rollout 100% complete for service=embedder image=tokenizer-v2.3.1-hotfix. No auto-rollbacks triggered.

sasha: nice — please follow up with a 2h post-deploy check and confirm no late regressions.

ops-duty: closing expedite window. changelog updated and Dedicated pinned. tagging ops-runbook for post-check.

maya: thanks team — will post post-deploy verification summary in 2h.
